declarations.rationale: P0–P4 are direct base/headquarters/company-location paths (57/60 rows); beginning is a competing meaning.
P0–P7 mix president/head/chair/leader offices; explicit director paths also recur. Select the existing mixed office family, excluding founding/ownership and ordinary service.
Executive title paths P0–P2/P5/P9/P10 dominate (46/59 rows); chair alone is a distinct competing title, not added to scope.
Country/nationality-modified president, government, leader and republic paths dominate in the inverse body-to-person direction; meetings/candidate edges compete.
Explicit economist at/for/of/with P0–P3 dominate43/58; director/principal/researcher remain distinct.
Unit/part/owned-by/parent paths P0–P6 dominate child-to-parent dictionary; executive and sale attachment are competing noise.
Scoring-for and player/center/guard/wing/captain paths establish the athlete-to-team roles for the recurring lead path; bare lead does not itself prove athlete identity.
Attorney title overwhelmingly dominates; jurisdiction-role noun modifiers require case-level distinction from private geographic location, and nominations are not tenure.
Accuse16/criticize9/attack6 plus directed criticism P7 dominate; warning, transfers and control remain distinct meanings.
Organizational part/unit/division and owned-by dominate P0–P11/P14; office-of attachment must resolve case locally.
Spokesman/spokeswoman-for and possessive paths dominate; director/secretary/adviser are distinct competing offices.
Leave8/move-from5+4/move-out2/take-out1 form the largest coherent directional movement family; return-to9 and leave-for2 oppose it. Literal roles include teams leaving named cities.
Base/company/firm/campus-in P0–P6 dominate; source is organization and target geographic place, with person/industry noise retained for grading.
Company/firm noun modifiers, base-in, firm-in and organizational geographic paths dominate P0–P9; no silent expansion to nationality-only affiliation.
Review-performance/program/production/work dominates whole dictionary; venue-at edges compete and require performer-versus-venue attachment review.

Victory-designated event13, win4, explicit championship2 and coaching-to-victory2 dominate winning evidence. Literal targets are sporting events; team/event membership and reaching an event remain outside winning scope.
Move-to/leave-for/take-to/relocate and move noun paths dominate; geographic roles include team relocation. From-source and playing-in are competing meanings.
Live-in P0/P1/P5 and death-at-home P4 form the largest coherent family17 rows; travel/arrival/work are substantial separate meanings and do not broaden residence.
Inverse possessive president/leader/dictator and president-of paths dominate; explicit political body-to-person roles, with encounter and unspecified minister boundaries.
Ask18/persuade11/call-on10/warn2 are directed communications from source to addressee; campus and treaty edges remain outside scope.
Born/bear-in P0–P2 total25/43 plus P5/P8 dominate; growing, native, residence and schooling remain distinct predicates.
Firm-in/firm-nn/company-dep/based-firm dominate; ambiguous nationality and untyped attachments retained for full case review.
Come/go/arrive/bring/visit/return-to dominate; place of meetings or events and nationality remain distinct from source movement.
